task: Prevent draft/private event tickets from leaking through public ticket endpoints while preserving producer management
evidence: Confirmed legacy public GET /ticket, /ticket/show/{id}, and /ticket/event/{eventId} queried Ticket/Event without Event::publiclyVisible(), exposing ticket inventory/pricing for draft/private/cancelled events.
Public ticket list and detail now require the related event to satisfy the shared Event::publiclyVisible() scope; event ticket listing now resolves only a publicly visible event.
Authenticated producer write endpoints and listByProduction/listByUser management paths were intentionally left unchanged, preserving draft-event ticket setup.
Modern Cutinapp v1 producer flow remains independent: /v1/apps/{application}/events/{eventId}/tickets and /tickets are authenticated under app.context/capabilities.
tests: Static inspection of route middleware and controller query scopes completed.
No VPS/build/deploy executed by policy; owner performs local runtime validation.
risk: Low: change narrows only legacy unauthenticated read visibility to the existing canonical public-event scope.
gate_status: Ticket inventory privacy hardened; producer draft ticket management preserved.
next_independent_blocker: Audit Mercado Pago webhook/order finalization for idempotent paid-state transition and exactly-once pass issuance; separately, cutinapp-launch-events owns the P0 create-draft -> first-ticket -> publish frontend blocker.
